```haskell
module Main where

import Data.Array

main :: IO ()
main = do
    input <- getContents
    let n = read (head (words input)) :: Int
        counts = listArray (0, n)
            [ if i == 0
                then 0
                else counts ! (i `div` 2) + (i `mod` 2)
            | i <- [0..n]
            ]
    putStrLn (unwords [show (counts ! i) | i <- [0..n]])
